metadata.source_authority: Open Admin Data Nigeria community dataset
metadata.source_title: Nigeria administrative divisions compiled public extract
metadata.cross_check_authority: National Bureau of Statistics, Independent National Electoral Commission, and Federal Capital Territory Administration
metadata.canonicalization: Retained source display names except that FCT Abuja Municipal was expanded to Abuja Municipal Area Council from FCTA terminology; normalized search names and deterministic slugs are separate; source keys became deterministic project public identifiers.
metadata.official_code_policy: ISO 3166-2 codes are retained only for the 36 States and the Federal Capital Territory.
metadata.project_code_policy: QMDB-NG-L2-{source-key} codes are project-owned immutable canonical identifiers for level-2 units and are not official government codes.
metadata.known_limitations: The public source file is a compiled data extract. NBS, INEC and FCTA source material is recorded as institutional corroboration; disputed future naming or boundary changes require a new governed dataset version.
